{{Quote|What has happened to democracy? And why doesn't anyone seem to care?''"<br />"''Well, you do. Forgive me, my lady. You're not like most politicians.|Padmé Amidala and Teckla Minnau|<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />}}
'''Teckla Minnau''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] who served as a [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaiden]] to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. [[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Parrlay]], Minnau attended a [[Theed private school|private school]] in Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] with her half-sister, [[Nandi]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], when the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and [[Capture of Theed/Legends|attacked]] Theed, Minnau fled to an outlying [[Unidentified Naboo village (marsh)|marsh village]], where she waited out the invasion. Though she was separated from Nandi for the duration of the Federation's occupation, they were reunited at the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo people's]] victory celebrations. The half-sisters entered into service to Senator Amidala, and in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], they managed her [[Naberrie family/Legends|family's]] [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]] residence of [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]].

At the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|dawn]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Minnau was sent to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to become part of Amidala's staff at the [[Naboo Embassy]]. While raising children in the difficulties of wartime, Minnau provided moral support for Amidala during her career in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]], particularly during Amidala's campaign against a [[Republic military enhancement bill/Legends|military increase bill]].

In the [[20 BBY/Legends|final month]] of the war, Minnau accompanied Amidala on a [[Mission to Scipio/Legends|mercy mission]] to [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]], the headquarters of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. During the ensuing negotiations, Amidala was forced to collaborate with Banking Clan representative [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]], a former colleague and old flame, who suspected the [[Core Five/Legends|Core Five]] leadership of corruption but so far lacked evidence to prove his claims. Minnau and Amidala agreed to help Clovis gain access to the Banking Clan's [[Main Vault/Legends|Main Vault]], but while covertly [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaging]] the Vault's [[Main Vault power generator/Legends|power generator]], Minnau was shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Embo/Legends|Embo]]. Her actions allowed Amidala and Clovis to gain the necessary evidence and expose the Core Five as embezzlers.

==Biography==
===Early life on Naboo===
{{Quote|If only that were enough, Teckla.''"<br />"''Well, ''you'' actually talk to the people. People like ''me''.|Padmé Amidala and Teckla Minnau, on the latter's comment about the former's uniqueness as a politician|<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />}}
[[File:Teckla_serving_fruit.png|thumb|left|300px|Minnau works as a waitress at Varykino in 22 BBY.]]
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] Teckla Minnau was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Parrlay]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], to a middle-class [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Minnau family|family]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She grew up with her half-sister, [[Nandi]], and they formed a close relationship in a childhood that was largely free of incident. They were eventually sent to Naboo's [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], where they stayed at the household of their [[law clerk]] brother, [[Rehtul Minnau]], and attended a [[Theed private school|private school]] to be instructed in the ways of hospitality, history, etiquette, and the arts.<ref name="Databank" />

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] Naboo,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> and Theed was [[Capture of Theed/Legends|attacked]]. Just [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after the Federation assault, as [[Lightfight|gun battles]] raged through Theed's streets, Minnau and Nandi accompanied members of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] in fleeing to nearby [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]]. The half-sisters were separated while doing so, and for several [[Standard day/Legends|days]], Minnau had to avoid Federation [[Bomber/Legends|bombing]] runs and [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platform]] patrols. After reaching a [[Unidentified Naboo village (marsh)|marsh village]], Minnau waited out the rest of the invasion there<ref name="Databank" /> until Naboo had been liberated by forces led by [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> During the celebrations of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] victory, Minnau was reunited with Nandi, and they went on to complete their schooling.<ref name="Databank" />

Within a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] of the Invasion of Naboo, Minnau and Nandi became employed as servants of Amidala, who had since risen to be Naboo's [[Senator/Legends|representative]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]]. While Amidala worked in the Senate on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Minnau and Nandi remained on Naboo to manage the senator's [[Naberrie family/Legends|family]] estate, [[Varykino Villa/Legends|Varykino Villa]], on the island of [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] in the [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]],<ref name="Databank" /> where they worked as [[Waiter/Legends|resort waitresses]].<ref name="AOTCn">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> after being targeted by a [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|series of attempts on her life]], Amidala returned to Naboo with a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and decided to stay at Varykino. Minnau and Nandi waited on Amidala and Skywalker at the estate during the pair's dinner,<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> serving freshly hand-picked [[Shuura/Legends|shuura]] [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] after their meal<ref name="Databank" /> and then returning to clean up the pair's plates.<ref name="AOTCn" />

===The Clone Wars===
====Aide to Amidala====
=====The Clone Wars begin=====
{{Quote|What has happened to democracy? And why doesn't anyone seem to care?"''<br />''"Well, you do.|Amidala and Minnau|<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />}}
It was only a short [[Time/Legends|time]] later that the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|broke out]] across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], and Minnau was subsequently recalled to join Amidala's staff at Coruscant's [[Naboo Embassy]].<ref name="Databank" /> In her new position as a [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaiden]] for Amidala,<ref name="Pursuit of Peace Ep Guide" /> Minnau was once again separated from Nandi.<ref name="Databank" /> Minnau began to raise children of her own, but because of the war, the district where her family lived had sparse access to running [[Water/Legends|water]] and electricity, to the point that her children had no light to read or study by at night and could only bathe every two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]]. Despite those hindrances,<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> Minnau remained a loyal [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to Amidala,<ref name="Clone Card" /> striking up a close relationship with her<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> while also gaining her trust.<ref name="CSWE Minnau">{{CSWECite|II|317|Minnau, Teckla}}</ref>

[[File:Teckla-Headdress.png|thumb|right|270px|Minnau encouragingly presents Amidala with her headpiece to wear before the Senate.]]
Following a Senate debate on a [[Republic military enhancement bill/Legends|proposal]] to escalate [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Cloning/Legends|production]], which would sustain and expand the Republic's war effort against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Minnau accompanied Amidala from the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] back to her [[Padmé's office/Legends|office]] in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]]. Minnau brought back a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and waited while Amidala spoke with her close allies, Senators [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] and [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], about defeating the [[Troop/Legends|troop]] increase bill.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />

=====Bounty hunters=====
{{Quote|Teckla is one of my aides. Like so many of the people that we tell ourselves we're here to serve, Teckla lives in a district that rarely has electricity and running water as a result of the war. Her children can now only bathe every two weeks, and they have no light in which to read or study at night.|Padmé Amidala, in an address to the full Republic Senate|<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />}}
[[File:Teckla-PoP.png|thumb|left|275px|Amidala and Minnau had a meaningful conversation.]]
A night later, when Amidala, bruised and battered after a run-in with [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], returned to her [[Naboo Queen (restaurant)|Naboo Embassy apartment]], Minnau treated her facial wounds with an antiseptic. Though Minnau suggested that Amidala report the incident to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], the senator refused, as she knew that her assailants had been trying to prevent her from voting against the troop increase. Minnau provided moral support for Amidala, who was losing hope with her prospects of defeating the bill. At Amidala's request, Minnau stayed at the apartment to tell her about the war's effect on her family, a conversation that Amidala took to [[Heart/Legends|heart]].<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />

When Organa was injured by the same [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters who had attacked Amidala, he was unable to deliver the oppositional speech that was to precede the final vote on the clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] escalation bill, and the task of addressing the Senate fell to Amidala. Although Amidala was not confident that her fellow [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] would listen to her on account of her partisanship, Minnau, presenting her senator with her formal Senatorial headpiece, convinced her to speak before the Senate by citing the fact that she truly understood the war's impact on the Republic citizenry. Minnau followed Amidala to the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate Chamber]], where she watched her address the Senate body.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />

In a speech that was broadcast across Coruscant,<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> Amidala provided a moving account of the war's effects on Minnau, an everyday civilian,<ref name="Pursuit of Peace Ep Guide" /> and her family, articulating her belief that the longer the conflict went on, the more it would consume funds for the people's basic services.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> Her address stirred the Senate,<ref name="Pursuit of Peace Ep Guide" /> and her colleagues received it with a thunderous round of applause.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> Because of her speech about Minnau, Amidala won much support in the Senate,<ref name="UK Comic 6.20">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.20|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.20]]</ref> though the bill to heighten clone trooper production was ultimately passed.<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>

====Negotiations on Scipio====
=====A surprise friend=====
{{Dialogue|Clovis|Look, it's not safe. We can't talk here.|Minnau|Senator, I really don't think&hellip;|Amidala|It's all right. I want to hear what he has to say.|attr=Teckla Minnau attempts to dissuade Padmé Amidala from speaking with Rush Clovis|src=<ref name="An Old Friend">{{TCW|An Old Friend}}</ref>}}
[[File:ArrivalOnScipio-AOF.png|thumb|right|270px|Minnau and Amidala are received outside the Main Vault's neutral zone by Mak Plain.]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|19.1 BBY]], the final [[Standard month/Legends|month]] of the Clone Wars,<ref name="An Old Friend Date" /> Minnau traveled with Amidala on a [[Mission to Scipio/Legends|mercy mission]] to the planet [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]], the headquarters of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. Amidala sought to secure a new loan from the Banking Clan to aid [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] who had been displaced from their homes by the war. Minnau accompanied Amidala, a pair of [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]], and Banking Clan representative [[Nix Card/Legends|Nix Card]] aboard the [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|GX1 Short Hauler]]<ref name="An Old Friend" /> [[Valorous/Legends|''Valorous'']],<ref name="Explore: An Old Friend">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/an-old-friend-episode-guide|text="An Old Friend" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> which landed at the [[Unidentified Scipio city|city]] surrounding the [[Main Vault/Legends|Main Vault]] amidst the icy [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] of Scipio.<ref name="An Old Friend" />

[[Mak Plain/Legends|Mak Plain]], a Banking Clan official, received Amidala, Minnau, and their associates at the entrance to the neutral zone surrounding the Main Vault, where all monetary transactions were conducted free of partisanship to the Republic and the Confederacy. While the Senate Commandos remained outside with the ''Valorous'', Minnau followed Amidala and the Banking Clan representatives into the neutral zone and proceeded to the Vault's main rotunda. There, Amidala met with the [[Core Five/Legends|Core Five]], the primary leadership of the Banking Clan. As Core Five spokesman [[Clu Lesser/Legends|Clu Lesser]] introduced the special representative who would be directly discussing the terms with Amidala, Minnau and her senator were surprised to see [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] enter the rotunda.<ref name="An Old Friend" />

[[File:TecklaWarning.png|thumb|left|280px|Minnau warns Amidala]]
Clovis was the former senator of Scipio, and though he had been romantically involved with Amidala a number of years ago, he had been [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia/Legends|exposed]] as a war profiteer, having provided funding for a major Separatist [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|battle droid foundry]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="Senate Spy">{{TCW|Senate Spy}}</ref> Amidala outright refused to collaborate with Clovis and blocked further progress until he was removed from the negotiations. That night, Plain showed Amidala and Minnau to their guest quarters, and Minnau thanked Plain before he left. Immediately thereafter, Minnau noticed someone creeping up behind Amidala and shouted a warning.<ref name="An Old Friend" />

=====Assassination attempts=====
{{Quote|My lady! Watch out!|Minnau, to Amidala regarding Clovis|<ref name="An Old Friend" />}}
Amidala, having smuggled an [[ELG-3A blaster pistol/Legends|ELG-3A blaster pistol]] into the neutral zone, aimed her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] at the intruder: Clovis. He told Amidala that he needed her help, and though Minnau protested, Amidala decided to hear him out and followed him out onto the room's balcony to confer privately. Clovis explained that while he suspected there were no financial funds remaining in the banks, the evidence was out of his reach within the records of the Main Vault, to which only the Core Five were permitted entry.<ref name="An Old Friend" />

Just then, [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] shots fired by the bounty hunter [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], who was too far away to be identified, narrowly missed Clovis and Amidala, the latter of whom ran back into the suite to take refuge with Minnau. Clovis pleaded with Amidala to pressure the Core Five into opening access to the Main Vault, then escaped on a [[Hover sledge/Legends|hover sledge]] that he had parked several [[Meter/Legends|meters]] beneath the balcony. After the local [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|authorities]] arrived to verify that Amidala was safe, Minnau saw the security agents off, while Amidala [[holograph]]ically contacted [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to discuss Clovis's suspicions.<ref name="An Old Friend" />

[[File:TecklaPlan.png|thumb|right|270px|Minnau (left) during the planning]]
When negotiations with the Core Five resumed the next morning, Amidala successfully petitioned the Banking Clan leaders to grant her access to the Main Vault the following day. During a subsequent break from the talks, Minnau and Amidala accompanied Clovis aboard the [[H-2 executive shuttle/Legends|H-2 executive shuttle]]<ref name="An Old Friend" /> [[Scipio (H-2 executive shuttle)/Legends|''Scipio'']]<ref name="Explore: An Old Friend" /> to his [[Rush Clovis's residence/Legends|personal residence]] in a remote area outside the city. Inside, Minnau joined Amidala while the latter discussed with Clovis their plan to retrieve the hidden files within the Main Vault. Clovis intended to set off an explosive charge at the Main Vault's [[Main Vault power generator/Legends|power generator]], which would plunge the entire facility into shutdown. In the brief interlude preceding the backup generator's activation, Amidala would use a device to locate the secret data files and download them from the [[Computer/Legends|mainframe]]. Presently, Minnau informed Amidala that she would be retiring for the night, and her senator did the same shortly thereafter.<ref name="An Old Friend" />

=====Teckla's end=====
{{Quote|They say Teckla is dead. Is it true?''"<br />"''Yes. She was found shot at the bomb site.|Amidala and Anakin Skywalker following Minnau's death|<ref name="An Old Friend" />}}
[[File:TecklaTargeted-AOF.png|thumb|left|270px|Minnau catches sight of Embo's targeting light, only moments prior to her death.]]
The next morning, Minnau went with Clovis and Amidala to the Main Vault, where they met Plain, the Core Five, and several Muun security agents. After the Core Five had entered the Vault with Amidala, Clovis attempted to sneak off to plant his detonator at the power generator. However, Plain stopped Clovis and pressured him into waiting for Amidala to return, since opening the Vault had been his idea.<ref name="An Old Friend" />

Noticing Clovis's dilemma, Minnau discreetly took the explosive charge from him and undertook his part of the scheme. She proceeded down several levels to the generator superstructure, and once she had glanced around to make sure no one had spotted her, she placed the detonator onto the structure. Unbeknownst to her, a minute [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] sent by Embo had located her. Embo aimed at her from a long distance away with his [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]], and Minnau halted in her tracks when she saw his bowcaster's targeting light on her body. She frantically scanned her surroundings, but before she could pinpoint her attacker, Embo fired a single shot that killed her. Mere [[Standard second|seconds]] later, Minnau's explosive activated, compromising the entire power grid and allowing Amidala to surreptitiously retrieve the required data files from the Vault mainframe.<ref name="An Old Friend" />

In the Muun authorities' following investigation into the power grid failure, Minnau's body was found at the scene of the bomb site, and it was concluded that she had [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] the power grid. Although Minnau's murderer went unidentified,<ref name="An Old Friend" /> Amidala and Clovis were able to use the recovered data files to expose the Core Five as the masterminds of an embezzling scandal that had depleted the banks.<ref name="The Rise of Clovis">{{TCW|The Rise of Clovis}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I've been against this bill from day one. If they didn't listen to me before, why would they listen now?''"<br />"''Because you ''do'' listen. You understand what the people are going through. Please. Your people are waiting for you.|Padmé Amidala is convinced by Teckla Minnau to speak before the full Senate|<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />}}
[[File:Amidala-Minnau.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Minnau was loyal to Amidala and shared a close relationship with her.]]
Standing 1.68 meters tall, Teckla Minnau had fair skin, [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. A loyal aide to Senator Padmé Amidala,<ref name="Clone Card" /> she possessed enough skill in the fields of etiquette and hospitality to serve Amidala and her family. A resourceful individual, Minnau was able to survive the Invasion of Naboo despite being in great danger.<ref name="Databank" /> She earned Amidala's trust<ref name="CSWE Minnau" /> and placed the senator's needs before her own without complaint.<ref name="Clone Card" />

She dutifully tended to Amidala's wounds after the senator was injured in an encounter with bounty hunters, and she was of the belief that Amidala should report the encounter to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]. Minnau did not support Amidala simply through matters of administration or physical treatment. She was quite concerned for her senator on a personal level, providing words of encouragement when Amidala was losing hope that no one else cared about the ongoing deterioration of democracy within the Senate. Because Amidala was willing to interact with "people like" herself, Minnau believed that her senator was unlike most politicians in that she actually listened to the words of the people, was concerned for the wartime struggles they were going through, and cared about their needs<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />&mdash;such principles, Minnau saw, were a strength of Amidala's.<ref name="Explore: Pursuit of Peace">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/pursuit-of-peace-episode-guide|text="Pursuit of Peace" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref>

Minnau was timid at times; while attempting to comfort Amidala following the bounty hunters' attempt on her life, she became embarrassed when she felt that she had said too much and subsequently made to leave. However, she stayed when Amidala asked that she tell her about her family and their repercussions from the war. Minnau later mustered up the confidence to convince Amidala to speak before the Senate in place of Bail Organa, citing Amidala's trait for understanding the war's true effect on the civilian populace. Because of Minnau's conviction, Amidala was able to find her own confidence to address the full Senate.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> Minnau displayed a measure of distrust for Rush Clovis, directly voicing to Amidala her belief that meeting with Clovis was not a good idea. Nevertheless, Minnau agreed to assist Clovis in his endeavor to gain access to the Banking Clan's Main Vault. When Clovis was held up by Mak Plain and was unable to plant his explosive charge at the power generator, Minnau even took it upon herself to complete Clovis's part of the plan, an action that ultimately cost her her life. She was able to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]],<ref name="An Old Friend" /> and her first name was fairly common among Humans.<ref name="Galactic Campaign Guide">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
At Varykino, Minnau wore a simple blue dress with a matching head cap.<ref name="AOTC" /> While serving Amidala on Coruscant, she donned a hooded, lavender-colored outfit.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> During the negotiations on Scipio, she wore a full-length maroon [[Robe/Legends|robe]].<ref name="An Old Friend" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Notable appearances===
{{Quote|Teckla Minnau's character name was pieced together over time from multiple sources.|[[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|Episode Guide]] for "Pursuit of Peace"|<ref name="Pursuit of Peace Ep Guide" />}}
[[File:MinnauConcept-POP.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art of Teckla Minnau for her appearance in "Pursuit of Peace"]]
The character of Teckla was created for the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> released [[May 16]], [[2002]],<ref name="Movie date">{{ThisWeek|u0Z7i0LnXOg|Mandalorian Season 2 Directors, We Celebrate a Birthday, and More!|sw_url=video/mandalorian-season-2-directors-we-celebrate-a-birthday-and-more}}</ref> where she was portrayed by [[Natalie Lewis]].<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|username=pabl0hidalgo|url=status/1490565332209000450|name=[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=She's played by Natalie Lewis.}}</ref> She made her first appearance prior to the film in author [[R. A. Salvatore]]'s<ref name="AOTCn" /> [[April 23]]<ref name="Cargo Bay">{{RandomHouseOld|url=author/results.pperl?authorid=26771|text=R.A. Salvatore}}</ref> [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novelization]] of the film, in which she was identified by her first name.<ref name="AOTCn" /> It was not until [[2008]]<ref name="Pursuit of Peace Ep Guide" /> that the character's backstory was elaborated upon in a [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry by [[Evan Burger]], writing as "Shadowcultist," through the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature ''[[What's The Story?]]''.<ref name="Databank" /> In using the surname "Minnau" for Teckla, Burger alluded to the name that actor [[Nathan Hamill]] had created for his own character, Rehtul Minnau, in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="Pursuit of Peace Ep Guide" />

On [[December 3]] [[2010]], eight years after her first appearance, Minnau was given a prominent role in "[[Pursuit of Peace]]," the eleventh episode in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]], in which she was voiced by actress [[Ashley Moynihan]].<ref name="Pursuit of Peace Ep Guide" /> She later appeared in the episode "[[An Old Friend]]," which was released in [[March]] [[2014]] with the series' [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]].<ref name="Explore: An Old Friend" /> For that episode, actress [[Anna Graves]] provided Minnau's vocal portrayal.<ref name="An Old Friend" /> Of note, "Pursuit of Peace" shows Minnau with green eyes,<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> differing from Natalie Lewis's brown eyes, which were also visible for the character.<ref name="Databank" /> This article treats the green eyes as [[canon]].

===Original fate===
{{Quote|Upon Amidala's untimely death and the rise of the New Order, Teckla returned to her homeworld to live out the rest of her life, marrying an aspiring writer and eventually becoming a trusted handmaiden under Queen Kylantha.|Teckla Minnau's original fate in the Databank|<ref name="Databank" />}}
"An Old Friend" depicts Minnau dying at the hands of the bounty hunter Embo,<ref name="An Old Friend" /> contrary to Evan Burger's original description of her life in her Databank entry. According to that entry, after Amidala becomes pregnant, Minnau is one of the few beings entrusted with the knowledge of her senator's pregnancy, and she becomes a caretaker and [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]] to Amidala.<ref name="Databank" />

Following Amidala's death and Supreme Chancellor Palpatine's [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Databank" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Minnau returns to Naboo. She [[Marriage/Legends|marries]] an [[Teckla Minnau's spouse|aspiring writer]] and eventually becomes a handmaiden to Naboo's [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Kylantha]].<ref name="Databank" /> This article assumes that the aforementioned portion of Minnau's Databank entry has been [[Retroactive continuity|overwritten]], given her death in "An Old Friend."
